    """Text between the first `<title>` and the next `</title>` in html, or "" when there is none."""
    ex title_of("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") == "Hello"
    ex title_of("<html></html>") == ""
    ex title_of("<title>Unclosed") == ""
    ex title_of("") == ""
    head, sep, rest = html.partition("<title>")
    if sep == "":
        return ""
